meta.protocol: train 2019-2023 (tuning window + disjoint confirmation window), validation 2024-01-01..2025-12-31 scored once per parameter set (ledger data/derived/mlcal_val_ledger.json), no 2026 fight loaded; winner log loss is corner-symmetric (fixed-hash corner swap in tuning, both orders in validation)
